summary: Learn to evaluate building use, occupant feedback, and facilities performance. Build practical POE plans and action registers. Explore the course.
lede: Post-occupancy evaluation (POE) helps facilities and workplace teams assess how public and commercial buildings perform once occupied. It equips facilities managers, estates teams, workplace managers and property consultants to plan evaluations that connect occupant experience with observed space use and operational records. Participants practise designing surveys, mapping evidence, analyzing findings and prioritizing corrective actions with clear ownership, using digital collection and reporting workflows where appropriate.
audienceIntro: Post-occupancy evaluation training is designed for professionals who assess building performance in use and coordinate improvements between occupants, property teams, and facility operations.
prerequisites: Prerequisites: Working familiarity with facilities, the workplace, estates, property, or building operations. Previous post-occupancy evaluation experience is not required. No coding is required; digital exercises use spreadsheet and survey workflows, subject to access to the relevant software.
